notes: Album support end-to-end: songs now remember their album everywhere — editing a song's info, searching, By-artist+album groups (tapping an album plays it), album auto-fill from the metadata backend when missing — and the field rides along in library backup/import.

Check for updates is honest now: on a network failure it tells you the real error instead of silently claiming you're on the latest version; the same buttons now actually check in the browser/PWA too (previously they said 'nothing to check'), and both toasts report 'latest' / 'new version available — reload' truthfully.

Pinned-artist covers stopped vanishing: the 'broken image' fallback could erase a custom picture you set (the WebView fires a spurious error mid-paint on data: photos,and the old code swapped your picture for a gradient initial). Now user-set photos are never replaced,automatic iTunes covers still fill in for artists without one.

Export library no longer crashes right after 'Exporting runs fast and saves your file:the native path used to read the ENTIRE zip into one base64 string (a multi-MB heap blowup on big libraries). It now writes the zip to the app cache in 256KB chunks (same file, same share sheet), so peak memory stays flat no matter how big your library is.
